paraphrases.note: check out 在美式英语中常见。
paraphrases.translation: 借书可以表示为从图书馆借书、查出书名、使用图书馆借阅。

paraphrases.note: patron 是图书馆服务语境的正式用词。
paraphrases.translation: 图书馆用户可以表示为顾客、会员、读者。

paraphrases.note: provision 强调公共服务供给。
paraphrases.translation: 免费使用计算机可以表现为公共数字访问、共享计算机提供、免费使用设备。

paraphrases.note: workspace 可用于学习和工作。
paraphrases.translation: 学习场所可以表现为安静的工作空间、共享学习区、独立学习空间。
寻找可信来源可以表现为获取可靠信息、找到可信材料、评估信息来源。

paraphrases.note: programme 比 activity 更正式。
paraphrases.translation: 图书馆活动可以表现为社区活动、公共研讨会、图书馆活动。

paraphrases.note: library of things 是特定服务模式。
paraphrases.translation: 借阅对象可以表现为经营图书馆、共享实用设备、提供非图书借阅。
保持集合有用可以表达为维护集合、响应本地需求、管理共享资源。

sentences.pattern: Far from being merely + outdated role, the library now + modern function.
sentences.cn: 图书馆远不只是某种过时场所，如今还……。
sentences.example: Far from being merely a storehouse of books, the library now provides access to digital services.
sentences.exampleTranslation: 该图书馆不再只是一个藏书的仓库，现在还提供数字服务。

sentences.pattern: For people who lack + resource, + library provision + may be the only way to + action.
sentences.cn: 对于缺少某种资源的人，图书馆服务可能是……的唯一途径。
sentences.example: For people who lack a quiet room, a library desk may be the only way to study effectively.
sentences.exampleTranslation: 对于缺乏安静房间的人来说，图书馆书桌可能是有效学习的唯一方法。

sentences.pattern: Not only does + library service + provide + resource, but it also + social benefit.
sentences.cn: 某项图书馆服务不仅提供……，还……。
sentences.example: Not only does a reading group provide motivation, but it also reduces social isolation.
sentences.exampleTranslation: 阅读小组不仅可以提供动力，还可以减少社交孤立。

expressions.example: I like to browse the shelves without a fixed title in mind.

expressions.example: You can renew the loan online unless another reader has reserved it.
expressions.exampleTranslation: 除非其他读者已预订，否则您可以在线续借。

expressions.example: The library gives residents a quiet place to study.
expressions.exampleTranslation: 图书馆为居民提供了一个安静的学习场所。

expressions.example: A librarian can help users access reliable information.
expressions.exampleTranslation: 图书馆员可以帮助用户获取可靠的信息。

mistakes.wrong: The library has many useful informations.

writingIdeas.viewpoint: Public libraries reduce inequalities that digital expansion can hide.
writingIdeas.topicSentence: Free shared access to space, devices and guidance remains essential in an online society.
writingIdeas.argument: Many applications for work, housing and public services now assume that users own a device and understand online forms. People without either can be excluded even when the service is described as universally available. Libraries provide computers, connectivity and staff who can explain a process without selling a product. They also offer a quiet workspace that crowded homes may lack. Their digital role therefore extends the traditional principle of equal access to knowledge.
writingIdeas.viewpointTranslation: 公共图书馆减少了数字扩张可能隐藏的不平等。
writingIdeas.topicSentenceTranslation: 在网络社会中，免费共享空间、设备和指导仍然至关重要。

argumentSentences.text: Many applications for work, housing and public services now assume that users own a device and understand online forms.
argumentSentences.translation: 现在，许多工作、住房和公共服务应用程序都假设用户拥有设备并理解在线表格。

argumentSentences.text: People without either can be excluded even when the service is described as universally available.
argumentSentences.translation: 即使该服务被描述为普遍可用，但没有任何一种服务的人也可能被排除在外。

argumentSentences.text: Libraries provide computers, connectivity and staff who can explain a process without selling a product.
argumentSentences.translation: 图书馆提供计算机、连接和可以在不销售产品的情况下解释流程的工作人员。

argumentSentences.text: They also offer a quiet workspace that crowded homes may lack.
argumentSentences.translation: 它们还提供了拥挤的家庭可能缺乏的安静的工作空间。

argumentSentences.text: Their digital role therefore extends the traditional principle of equal access to knowledge.
argumentSentences.translation: 因此，他们的数字角色延伸了平等获取知识的传统原则。

writingIdeas.viewpoint: Library value should not be judged only by book-loan totals.
writingIdeas.topicSentence: Modern libraries produce educational and social benefits that circulation figures cannot fully represent.
writingIdeas.argument: An advice session may prevent a user from abandoning an important form, while a weekly reading group can rebuild social contact for an isolated resident. Neither outcome appears as a conventional book loan. Counting visits, programme participation and successful referrals provides a broader picture, although not every benefit can be reduced to a number. Qualitative feedback can show why particular services matter. Funding decisions should reflect the library’s actual functions rather than a historical measure alone.
writingIdeas.viewpointTranslation: 图书馆的价值不应仅根据图书借阅总额来判断。
writingIdeas.topicSentenceTranslation: 现代图书馆产生的教育和社会效益是流通量数字无法完全体现的。

argumentSentences.text: An advice session may prevent a user from abandoning an important form, while a weekly reading group can rebuild social contact for an isolated resident.
argumentSentences.translation: 建议会议可以防止用户放弃重要的表格，而每周的阅读小组可以为孤立的居民重建社交联系。

argumentSentences.text: Neither outcome appears as a conventional book loan.
argumentSentences.translation: 这两种结果都不像传统的图书借阅。

argumentSentences.text: Counting visits, programme participation and successful referrals provides a broader picture, although not every benefit can be reduced to a number.
argumentSentences.translation: 统计访问次数、计划参与和成功推荐可以提供更广泛的情况，尽管并非所有好处都可以简化为数字。

argumentSentences.text: Qualitative feedback can show why particular services matter.
argumentSentences.translation: 定性反馈可以说明为什么特定服务很重要。

argumentSentences.text: Funding decisions should reflect the library’s actual functions rather than a historical measure alone.
argumentSentences.translation: 资助决策应反映图书馆的实际功能，而不仅仅是历史衡量标准。

speaking.question: When was the last time you used a library?
speaking.answer: I used one about two weeks ago because I needed a quiet place for concentrated work. I also borrowed a travel book that I had noticed on display, even though that was not why I went in. The building was busy but not noisy, and I stayed much longer than planned. It reminded me how useful a shared study space can be.
speaking.questionTranslation: 您最后一次使用图书馆是什么时候？

answerSentences.text: I used one about two weeks ago because I needed a quiet place for concentrated work.
answerSentences.translation: 大约两周前我去过一次图书馆，因为需要一个安静的地方专心工作。

answerSentences.text: I also borrowed a travel book that I had noticed on display, even though that was not why I went in.
answerSentences.translation: 我还借了一本我注意到陈列的旅游书，尽管这不是我进去的原因。

answerSentences.text: The building was busy but not noisy, and I stayed much longer than planned.
answerSentences.translation: 大楼很繁忙但并不吵闹，而且我停留的时间比计划的要长得多。

answerSentences.text: It reminded me how useful a shared study space can be.
answerSentences.translation: 它提醒我共享学习空间是多么有用。

speaking.question: Describe a library you have visited.
speaking.answer: The library I remember best is a small branch inside a renovated market building. The original brick walls remain, but the interior has bright reading tables, computers and a children’s corner. What impressed me was the mixture of users: pupils doing homework, older residents reading newspapers and jobseekers asking staff for help. It was not silent, yet each area had a clear purpose. The place felt more like public infrastructure than a room containing books. Staff had placed local-history material near the entrance, which connected the old building with the neighbourhood it now served. There was also a small room for workshops, so louder group activity did not disturb readers. I would return because the design made different uses compatible. It demonstrated that a modern library can be sociable without giving up spaces for concentration.
speaking.questionTranslation: 描述一下你参观过的图书馆。

answerSentences.text: The library I remember best is a small branch inside a renovated market building.
answerSentences.translation: 我记得最清楚的图书馆是一座翻新的市场大楼内的一个小分馆。

answerSentences.text: The original brick walls remain, but the interior has bright reading tables, computers and a children’s corner.
answerSentences.translation: 原来的砖墙仍然保留，但内部设有明亮的阅读桌、电脑和儿童角。

answerSentences.text: What impressed me was the mixture of users: pupils doing homework, older residents reading newspapers and jobseekers asking staff for help.
answerSentences.translation: 最令我印象深刻的是使用者很多样：有做作业的学生、读报的老年居民，还有向工作人员求助的求职者。

answerSentences.text: It was not silent, yet each area had a clear purpose.
answerSentences.translation: 那里并非完全安静，但每个区域都有明确用途。

answerSentences.text: The place felt more like public infrastructure than a room containing books.
answerSentences.translation: 这个地方感觉更像是公共基础设施，而不是一个装书的房间。

answerSentences.text: Staff had placed local-history material near the entrance, which connected the old building with the neighbourhood it now served.
answerSentences.translation: 工作人员在入口附近放置了当地历史资料，将旧建筑与其现在服务的社区连接起来。

answerSentences.text: There was also a small room for workshops, so louder group activity did not disturb readers.
answerSentences.translation: 还有一个小房间用于研讨会，因此大声的集体活动不会打扰读者。

answerSentences.text: I would return because the design made different uses compatible.
answerSentences.translation: 我会回来，因为设计使不同的用途兼容。

answerSentences.text: It demonstrated that a modern library can be sociable without giving up spaces for concentration.
answerSentences.translation: 它证明了现代图书馆可以在不放弃集中空间的情况下进行社交。

reading.title: The Library of Things
paragraphs: A growing number of public libraries lend objects as well as books. Their catalogues may include drills, sewing machines, musical instruments, cake tins and equipment for measuring household energy use. The idea is simple: many useful objects are needed occasionally, yet every household is expected to buy and store its own. A shared collection applies the familiar lending model to material goods.

The environmental argument is attractive. Manufacturing a power tool requires metals, energy, packaging and transport, although the tool may operate for only a few minutes each year. If one durable item serves many users, demand for rarely used products can fall. Savings are not automatic, however. Objects must survive repeated handling, and extra journeys to collect them may offset part of the benefit. Libraries need repair procedures rather than treating damaged equipment as disposable.

Access is another objective. A person can test an activity before spending money, while a tenant can borrow a tool for a small repair. Some schemes include demonstrations or safety checks, turning a transaction into practical learning. Liability is more complicated than with books: staff must decide which items require training, how cleanliness is maintained and what happens when equipment fails. These duties increase cost and may limit what can be offered.

The model also changes the meaning of a collection. Traditional libraries organise published knowledge for shared use; a library of things organises practical capacity. Both depend on trust, clear records and the principle that temporary access can be more valuable than ownership. Such schemes will not replace ordinary retail or private possessions. They are most convincing where an object is expensive, robust and infrequently required—precisely the circumstances in which individual ownership is least efficient.

Demand is also highly local. Musical instruments may circulate well near schools, whereas gardening tools may be useful in an area with shared allotments. Starting with a small collection and examining reservations, waiting times and repairs allows the service to respond to actual use. Copying another city’s catalogue without considering housing, transport and community partnerships can leave expensive objects untouched.

questions.prompt: Every object in a library of things is related to reading.
questions.explanation: Paragraph 1 lists tools, instruments and household equipment.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for paragraph 3.
questions.answer: Wider access accompanied by new responsibilities
questions.explanation: Paragraph 3 contrasts access and learning with safety and liability duties.

questions.prompt: What three qualities make an object particularly suitable for shared lending?
questions.answer: It is expensive, robust and infrequently required.
questions.explanation: The final sentence lists these three qualities.

paragraphSentencePairs.text: A growing number of public libraries lend objects as well as books.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 越来越多的公共图书馆不仅提供图书借阅服务，还提供物品借阅服务。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Their catalogues may include drills, sewing machines, musical instruments, cake tins and equipment for measuring household energy use.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 他们的目录可能包括钻头、缝纫机、乐器、蛋糕罐和测量家庭能源使用的设备。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: The idea is simple: many useful objects are needed occasionally, yet every household is expected to buy and store its own.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 这个想法很简单：偶尔需要许多有用的物品，但每个家庭都应该购买和储存自己的物品。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: A shared collection applies the familiar lending model to material goods.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 共享收藏将熟悉的借贷模式应用于物质商品。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: The environmental argument is attractive.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 环境论点很有吸引力。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Manufacturing a power tool requires metals, energy, packaging and transport, although the tool may operate for only a few minutes each year.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 制造电动工具需要金属、能源、包装和运输，尽管该工具每年可能只运行几分钟。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: If one durable item serves many users, demand for rarely used products can fall.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 如果一件耐用品为许多用户服务，那么对很少使用的产品的需求就会下降。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Savings are not automatic, however.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 然而，节省并不是自动的。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Objects must survive repeated handling, and extra journeys to collect them may offset part of the benefit.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 物品必须能够经受住反复搬运，而收集物品的额外旅程可能会抵消部分好处。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Libraries need repair procedures rather than treating damaged equipment as disposable.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 图书馆需要修复程序，而不是将损坏的设备视为一次性设备。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Access is another objective.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 访问是另一个目标。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: A person can test an activity before spending money, while a tenant can borrow a tool for a small repair.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 一个人可以在花钱之前测试一项活动，而租户可以借用一个工具进行小修。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Some schemes include demonstrations or safety checks, turning a transaction into practical learning.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 有些计划包括演示或安全检查，将交易转化为实际学习。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Liability is more complicated than with books: staff must decide which items require training, how cleanliness is maintained and what happens when equipment fails.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 责任比书本更复杂：员工必须决定哪些项目需要培训、如何保持清洁以及设备出现故障时会发生什么。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: These duties increase cost and may limit what can be offered.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 这些职责会增加成本并可能限制所能提供的服务。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: The model also changes the meaning of a collection.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 该模型还改变了集合的含义。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Traditional libraries organise published knowledge for shared use; a library of things organises practical capacity.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 传统图书馆整理已出版的知识以供共享；事物图书馆组织实用能力。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Both depend on trust, clear records and the principle that temporary access can be more valuable than ownership.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 两者都依赖于信任、清晰的记录以及临时访问比所有权更有价值的原则。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Such schemes will not replace ordinary retail or private possessions.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 此类计划不会取代普通零售或私人财产。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: They are most convincing where an object is expensive, robust and infrequently required—precisely the circumstances in which individual ownership is least efficient.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 当物品昂贵、坚固且不经常需要时，它们最有说服力——而这恰恰是个人所有权效率最低的情况。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Demand is also highly local.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 需求也高度本地化。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Musical instruments may circulate well near schools, whereas gardening tools may be useful in an area with shared allotments.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 乐器在学校附近可能流通良好，而园艺工具在共享土地的区域可能很有用。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Starting with a small collection and examining reservations, waiting times and repairs allows the service to respond to actual use.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 从少量收集开始，检查预订、等待时间和维修情况，使服务能够响应实际使用情况。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Copying another city’s catalogue without considering housing, transport and community partnerships can leave expensive objects untouched.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 复制另一个城市的目录而不考虑住房、交通和社区合作伙伴关系可能会让昂贵的物品原封不动。
